commands.command:
set -eu
for p in /root/os-comparison-root-ca /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt; do
  if [ -e "$p" ]; then ls -ld "$p"; else printf 'ABSENT %s\n' "$p"; fi
done
trust list 2>/dev/null | grep -F -A4 -B2 'OS Comparison Root CA' || true

set -eu
umask 077
install -d -m 700 /root/os-comparison-root-ca
openssl req -x509 -new -newkey rsa:4096 -sha256 -nodes \
  -keyout /root/os-comparison-root-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.key \
  -out /root/os-comparison-root-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.crt \
  -days 3650 \
  -subj '/CN=OS Comparison Root CA' \
  -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE' \
  -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' \
  -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash' \
  -addext 'authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid:always'
chmod 600 /root/os-comparison-root-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.key
chmod 644 /root/os-comparison-root-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
printf 'generated\n'

set -eu
install -o root -g root -m 0644 /root/os-comparison-root-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
update-ca-trust extract
printf 'installed\n'

set -eu
printf '%s\n' '--- certificate identity and CA capabilities ---'
openssl x509 -in /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -noout -subject -issuer -serial -dates -fingerprint -sha256
openssl x509 -in /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -noout -text | grep -A4 'X509v3 Basic Constraints'
printf '%s\n' '--- native trust-store verification ---'
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
trust list | grep -F -A5 -B2 'OS Comparison Root CA'
printf '%s\n' '--- private key protection and key/certificate match ---'
stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /root/os-comparison-root-ca /root/os-comparison-root-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.key /root/os-comparison-root-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
key_hash=$(openssl pkey -in /root/os-comparison-root-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.key -pubout 2>/dev/null | openssl sha256)
cert_hash=$(openssl x509 -in /root/os-comparison-root-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -pubkey -noout | openssl sha256)
printf 'private-key-public-hash=%s\ncertificate-public-hash=%s\n' "$key_hash" "$cert_hash"
[ "$key_hash" = "$cert_hash" ]
printf '%s\n' '--- unchanged platform ---'
. /etc/os-release
printf 'os=%s kernel=%s\n' "$PRETTY_NAME" "$(uname -r)"
